Data Centers Gap Analysis Ellie Estreich, Luke Lavin, Ilya Chernyakhovskiy GDO Planning for Large Loads Project February 2026 Photo from Getty-181828180 Data centers gap analysis • We analyze gaps in understanding U.S. grid and customer impacts of large load development. • We also identify and categorize mitigation options for near-term large load integration with the U.S. bulk power system. • Research questions: ◦ How are large loads driving near-term electricity growth? ◦ Which factors are important for siting large loads? ◦ What are realistic near-term mitigation options? ◦ Where are gaps in the data that would allow us to understand and/or model large loads better? ◦ Where should NLR prioritize adding value?
